svg.title: VLA-Mender: Evidence-Driven Closed-Loop Repair for VLA Policies
svg.desc: A publication-style overview of VLA-Mender. The repair panel distinguishes the prompt-mandated task-start knowledge review, the initial failure-mode candidate, the evidence-gated refinement loop, and the campaign-local current experience slot.
svg.text: VLA-Mender: Evidence-Driven Closed-Loop Repair for VLA Policies
Verified interventions expose recoverable failures; task-parallel agents convert them into reusable repair experience and targeted training data.
Knowledge review precedes the first candidate
One agent per task; persistent state per FM
updated policy is evaluated under the same reproducible protocol
Core repair design: prompt-grounded initialization followed by evidence-gated failure-mode research
Parallel across tasks; persistent and independent across failure modes.
queued when agent slots are full
PROMPT-MANDATED · BEFORE ANY CANDIDATE OR ROLLOUT
Decompose observable phases; identify required perception, action, control, and current failure mechanism.
Search the full relevant code space
aspire/repair catalogs · SKILL.md · exposed functions only; no private state
analysis · checklist · scopes; refreshable, not a runtime gate/provenance
Targeted reuse creates no duplicate candidate.
PERSISTENT RESEARCH STATE · ONE INSTANCE PER (TASK, FAILURE MODE)
all prepared seeds stay open until evaluator-backed coverage
INITIALIZATION · RUN ONCE AFTER THE KNOWLEDGE REVIEW
failures stay active; coverage is evaluator-only
REFINEMENT LOOP · ONE EVIDENCE-GROUNDED MECHANISM PER LATER CANDIDATE
wide/wrist + trajectory; smallest shared fix if needed
